items.when: Same run, whenever something goes wrong

Repo hygiene: Sweep checks the tracked tree against the lean budgets and removes stray, duplicate, dead, temp or build files in one ordinary PR. No history rewrites.

items.when: One to three roles a day, all week (in the daily run)
items.what: Weekly research rotation: each role reads up to about 5 public web pages in its own area and posts a short note. Ideas become pitches in the next standup.
Coordinator: select the week's investigations from the consolidated research (on top of the daily run).
Assigned roles research the selected questions. Each role's own rotation slot keeps running for independent research.
Critic challenges the strongest proposals, User Advocate checks the user problem, Shield and Trial weigh in as relevant, and cheap experiments run.
Approved, scored ideas with acceptance criteria are built through the usual review gates.
Analyst measures against each success metric, Librarian records outcomes, and the team retro runs. Urgent security issues or major Grok Bot updates can interrupt any day.

Week 1 shipped: progression rules, the XP ledger, and character sheets; the daily run refreshes the ledger with scripts/xp.py. Next: Week 2 quests, Week 3 the first team raid, Week 4 audit, rebalance, and skill trees. Each step starts on evidence, not the calendar.
